## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; leadership concentrated (Top 5 span Materials, Energy, Technology). Confirmations: very shallow breadth plus large-cap Tech weakness (AAPL (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -9.21%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.28% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND) while Energy shows clear strength (XOM (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +6.96%) ABOVE TREND).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +10.46%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +6.96%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing pockets of leadership: DOW (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) ABOVE TREND and APD (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY; Utilities is the second positive sector in the market breadth tally.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Financials weak: WFC (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -8.81%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -3.22% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND. Technology and Consumer Discretionary also lag with AAPL (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -9.21%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -4.83% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND and AMZN (1W: -2.60% | 1M: +1.76%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: DOW (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.46% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY, APD (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY, INTC (1W: +5.41% | 1M: -5.22%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Concentrated (Top 5 drawn mainly from Materials, Energy and Technology) — selectivity warranted.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: GE (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -4.34%) BELOW TREND, TMO (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -11.83%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%) BELOW TREND, KHC (1W: -7.99% | 1M: -8.13%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Industrials, Healthcare and Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: DOW (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%) ABOVE TRA ND, LRCX (1W: +6.46% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY, APD (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY, INTC (1W: +5.41% | 1M: -5.22%) RECOVERY; note MAJOR divergence among large names (NVDA (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -5.15%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +1.33% | 1M: -2.72%) RECOVERY, INTC RECOVERY) — tactical risk as short-term bounces contrast with weaker 1M trends.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech mixed-to-weak: AAPL (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -9.21%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -3.28% | 1M: -1.96%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -5.15%) RECOVERY, AMAT (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND, INTC (1W: +5.41% | 1M: -5.22%) RECOVERY — sector 1W: -2.05% and breadth clearly negative, so leadership remains narrow and patchy.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials broadly weak with WFC (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -8.81%) BELOW TREND and MS/large banks showing sentiment strains; sector 1W: -3.13% and majority of names under pressure, so Financials are not confirming a risk-on.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare soft: JNJ (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND is a lone defensive hold, while TMO (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -11.83%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -0.53% | 1M: -2.81%) BELOW TREND underline sector weakness (sector 1W: -2.40%).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective Energy and Materials exposure (XOM (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor AMAT (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND as a tech pocket of strength; reduce exposure to large-cap Tech that are BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, META). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt, but keep positions tactical given shallow breadth and short-term divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%) ABOVE TREND (news +50 confirms), COP (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +10.46%) ABOVE TREND (news +50 confirms), APD (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY (news +60 confirming upgrade). BEARISH: INTU (1W: -8.56% | 1M: +10.08%) CORRECTION (news -60 confirms guidance risk), META (1W: -4.83% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND (news -50 confirms), WFC (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%) BELOW TREND (macro/credit sensitivity).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (sector 1W: +2.38%; breadth positive) and pockets of Materials on company-specific catalysts. BEARISH: Technology and Financials remain the primary downside risk areas given weak 1W sector prints and headline-driven sentiment.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -5.15%) RECOVERY — watch follow-through above near-term resistance for validation of the bounce. XOM (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%) ABOVE TREND — monitor hold of recent support for continued leadership. AAPL (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -9.21%) BELOW TREND — a sustained move back above short-term range would be needed to shift the risk profile.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
APD (+60): upgrade/sector rehypothecation; price RECOVERY (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%) — sentiment confirming the short-term bounce. XOM (+50): analyst lift; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%) — sentiment confirming accumulation. COP (+50): analyst lift; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.12% | 1M: +10.46%) — sentiment and price aligned.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
INTU (-60): weak guidance headline; price CORRECTION (1W: -8.56% | 1M: +10.08%) — sentiment confirms near-term weakness and contradicts longer-term strength. META (-50): negative deal/AI headlines; price BELOW TREND (1W: -4.83% | 1M: -8.22%) — sentiment and price aligned on downside. GOOGL (-50): regulatory/press headlines; price RECOVERY (1W: +1.33% | 1M: -2.72%) — sentiment diverging from short-term price bounce, monitor for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; Value/Cyclical style given Energy and Materials pockets of strength. XOM (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +6.96%) ABOVE TREND and DOW (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major short-term/1M divergences among Tech leaders (NVDA, GOOGL, INTC) and negative news flow on INTU/META that could widen market dispersion.
